evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: This expresses a single feature (create a new game) with attribute fields; attributes do not make it multi-featured.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: inviting estimators via a URL; not multiple independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a round by entering an item; the input method is an attribute.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying all session items; the example question is a use-case, not a second feature.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single selection feature (choose item for estimate or re-estimate); 're-estimate' is a state of the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding an item; the reason for doing so does not add another implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: editing an item; editing multiple fields are attributes of the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting an item; straightforward atomic action.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: immediately revealing estimates; the justification explains when it is used, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accepting the average as the agreed estimate; not combined with another independently implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: auto-filling estimate under a specific condition; conditional behavior is part of one feature.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: entering the agreed estimate; atomic action.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: re-estimating a previously estimated story; one independently implementable action.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: importing stories; not combined with other features.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: copy/paste import; distinct from PP-014 but individually atomic.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: browsing prior games; the goal (find a specific game) is a use-case, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing transcripts; atomic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting transcript to HTML; specific export format is an attribute.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting to CSV; atomic and similar to PP-018 but not combined in one story.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting a game and its stored data; atomic action.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account creation; listed fields are attributes required for the one feature.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: authentication; credential fields are attributes of that feature.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: editing account details; multiple editable fields are attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account deletion; includes consequence but remains one implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: local timezone display; atomic non-functional requirement.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: password reminder via email; one independently implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: choosing the estimation scale; options are attributes of the one selection feature.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: invitation capacity limit; a constraint on one feature, not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: joining a game; the join method is an attribute of the feature.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the current item under estimation; atomic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: listing upcoming items; one implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: immediate visibility of who has estimated; atomic functionality.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: simultaneous reveal after all have voted; a single coherent feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ability to change estimate before reveal; the condition is part of the one feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing prior estimates for the current story; atomic and focused.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying per-estimator current-round estimates; one implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: shared countdown timer; atomic functionality.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic timer reset behavior tied to the timer feature; conditional behavior within one feature.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: scrolling back through prior rounds; one navigational feature.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: consistent card ordering; a single UI consistency requirement.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allow changing estimate before draw completion; atomic behavior similar to PP-034.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying a thumbnail next to played cards; one UI feature.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: standards compliance; multiple standards listed are attributes of the same quality feature.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: providing a glossary; atomic deliverable.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: creating indexes to improve query performance; one developer task.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: cross-browser compatibility requirement; listing browsers are attributes of the one compatibility feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accessibility compliance; atomic non-functional requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: performance/responsiveness requirement; one implementable concern.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: Unicode support; atomic internationalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: readable/predictable URL scheme; one coherent requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: custom error pages; atomic UX requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: anonymized storage of results; one privacy-related requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing usage metrics; atomic reporting feature.
